description:
Kim Eui-Hyun is an omega at his limit. After living a life of troubles and owing an unpayable debt that isn’t even his, he’s ready to give up. Hoping to spare himself and his little brother a life of more pain, he opts to walk into the cold depths of the sea. With his escape in reach, it seems like everything will be over soon—until someone catches him. Yeo Tae-Ju, a sadistic alpha who seems to take pleasure in other’s pain, gives Eui-Hyun the choice to pay off his debt with his body but when the omega refuses, Tae-Ju proves he has no other choice. 

Still desperate for escape, Eui-Hyun tries to plan his next attempt while doing restaurant work. But with a sorry paycheck that barely covers his interests and his little brother to care for, will Eui-Hyun have to sell his body after all just to survive? And, is it even worth surviving if this is what his life is meant to be? 

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment, edited)

*Note: Includes 17 extra chapters.*
